gc_diagnostics.scope: GX mode0 host thread CPU timing; not virtual or native latency

limitations: GX functional emulation does not compute model outputs; native validation compares returned uint8 videos. Equality after quantization does not establish prequantization finiteness or exact intermediate equality.

Repeated fixed prompt after warmup; public generation including sampling, VAE decode and CPU uint8 output. No UI, queue, previews, or file encoding. Quantization, adapters, alternative attention, concurrent requests and arbitrary model transitions are not validated.

Skipping redundant empty unload also skips allocator-cache clearing and resets of the memory-check clock at that call. Other cleanups remain. This workload has unchanged measured memory peaks; this is not a proof for memory pressure from unrelated allocations.
GX CPU calibration: 10829 resolved and 225 unresolved samples (2.04% unresolved). GX host EPYC 7702P differs from native A100 host EPYC 9554.
cuDNN plans and/or malformed launch dimensions differ between runs. Misses receive zero modeled compute cost; launch-count coverage is not time coverage.

Known-control adapters retain original GPU operations, then substitute tokenizer-derived lengths and CPU-derived sequential Euler indices for emulation. Native execution asserts agreement. No CFG-star or self-refinement is used.
Physical GPU1 was idle before validation; unrelated GPU0 work can share host resources.

additional_screen.hypothesis: Cache tiny read-only single-batch FlashAttention cu_seqlens per generation/device/stream, atop the empty-unload guard.
additional_screen.decision: Deprioritized after GX screen; no native validation or accepted optimization. Only ~0.2% modeled latency reduction.
additional_screen.flag: WAN2GP_CACHE_FLASH_SEQLENS=0 versus 1; MMGP_SKIP_EMPTY_UNLOAD=1 in both variants.
